source.method: Complete numbered original file reading followed by proposition-by-proposition review with original byte hashes and relevant actual line ranges. Source judgments are separate from native rendered facts.

additionalVisualInspection: All 18 independent reference PNGs: top/bottom catalogs for all states, and full permitted reference images for both cases. Reference rasterization was not treated as a pixel baseline.
Four primary-boundary sheets covering the 36 state/platform/case primary controls; same-frame native mapping retained in control-boundary-manifest.json.
limits: One independent AI assessor. This result is not human gold or a two-panel consensus.

The acceptance self-check supplies this same assessor JSON as both arguments solely to validate schema/binding and recompute authoritative facts. Its generated consensus wording does not supply independence.

Android P2 status-leading-clear remains U in all nine states: the approved original-pixel strip sampling has an eligible frame with insufficient unambiguous solid-color support. Some later frames are measurable, which does not override an insufficient eligible frame. No sampling threshold or expected value was changed.

iOS opened/cleared/restored/held-choice bind target-only evidence and make no full-content coverage claim. Their delivered qualitative atoms are target-scoped; five full visual states retain complete original overlapping sweeps.
Only delivered representative cases/states are assessed; no private cases, new runtime/SDK execution, physical hit-region proof, link/archive or older-OS runtime result is asserted.

Reference catalogs retain only top/bottom crops of the long states; long-content actual judgments were made against the complete original native sweeps and supplied fixture text, not these truncated reference catalogs.
